benefits.text: Eye makeup. Discover new perspectives and points of view with vivid textures and brilliant colors. Combining vivid shades with basic colors, this versatile palette of 10 colors suits every mood of yours.

howToUse.text: Use a finger or brush to pick up an appropriate amount, apply to the eye area you want to make up and blend gently.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

sellingPoints.text: 10 versatile colors; combines basic and accent shades; multiple finishes from matte to shimmer to build depth.

texture.text: Pressed eyeshadow, including matte, matte with shimmer, shimmer and sparkle.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim absolute color wear or 100% no fallout. For blue/shimmer shades, color payoff may vary depending on the eyelid base and blending technique.
